evaluation_kind: recorded-timing replay of the frozen scheduler scored by a model-based reference (NOT a real-QPU experiment; no outcomes are simulated)

model.equation: p_l(t) = A + B exp(-l/l0) sin(2 pi l t_w Omega(t)); Omega(t) = gamma_0 + sum_w gamma_w f_w(t)
model.selection_rule: min mean validation log loss = 0.710785; candidates within 0.001 nats: [2]; lowest BIC among them -> K=2

holdout_tracked_diagnostic.note: same K, A, B, l0; detuning coefficients re-estimated ON the holdout (in-sample diagnostic only)

grouping.method: average-linkage on RMS difference of model-implied window-to-window probability changes

metadata.score_formula: priority_score = 1.0 / (mean_abs_z + 1e-12); 0.0 if training data is insufficient

cv_block_count_selection.note: training-only re-selection with other chronological block counts; reported, never used to override the approved protocol
